clusters.name: Walter's move west, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country to Sorrel Valley in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter out in the trees and away from June, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother over land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir as her letters thinned out. The shifts pile up from May 1952 through September 1953, settling as June found her footing in the new place.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drinking heavily, conflict between Walter and Glen over blame for the loan, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and dealings with the bank, Carl's asthma worsening that winter, you wetting the bed again, your grandmother Ida's heart trouble found, and Walter stopping his drinking and taking work pruning trees. The shifts pile from June 1968 through October 1969, with the auction in early October marking the turn.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen out of work most of that year and sitting in the truck for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian over money at night, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, you stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, you keeping to your room and distancing from your mother, Walter drinking again after six years sober, and you eating again and making the track team by June 1976. This is the time you marked as standing out, when you were 14.

clusters.name: Wilma moving in, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Hollis's mother Wilma selling her farm and moving into your house in January 1990: you and Wilma clashing over the children's bedtimes and meals, you working late and keeping out of the kitchen rows, Hollis taking his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, you developing eczema on both hands, rows between you and Hollis most nights, and Wilma moving to a flat in town by June 1991 where your eczema cleared over the summer. The shifts run from April 1990 through August 1991, settling as Wilma moved out.
